scope_note: Source-specific intake, not a count of new or completed experiments. A case is ready only for its stated finite rule and source inputs. An unbounded choice of words, routes, or transforms is not an executable search.

next_shared_engine.name: source-derived-keystream-sweep
next_shared_engine.reason: The pinned Dukotah ledger contains several distinct finite key-source proposals that currently lack Liberpedia replays. One runner could share input hashing, key-byte to GP-29 conversion, optional skip-aware decoding, positive controls, full candidate accounting, calibrated selection thresholds, and held-out continuation. Candidate sources remain separate manifests; parameter combinations are cases, not new ideas.
next_shared_engine.first_slice: Audit and replay the 323-value semantic seed set against the source's seven generators and two decoders at offset zero. Then add the 256-byte grid payload PRF variants. Defer the multi-million-decode seed dictionary and dense public-pad grids until controls and source bytes pass in the smaller slices.

proposals.input: GP-29 plaintext and previous ciphertext rune

insertion-location recovery rule

proposals.criterion: full unedited output against fixed language/known-reading controls; no discretionary deletion or rearrangement
missing: F rule
line origin
out-of-range neighbor wrap
permitted postprocessing

proposals.source_locator: User message received 2026-10-23: numerical autokey / circumference shedding / instar emergence
proposals.title: Manuscript-derived numerical autokey and iterative emergence
proposals.input: An explicitly selected manuscript text layer and target pages; possibly the known LP2-57 parable or its documented prime-value totals. Original audio metadata is contextual evidence, not a key schedule.
proposals.transform: Hypothesis: plaintext or manuscript-derived numerical values feed back into decoding; an old state or text layer is discarded as the next state/reading is generated. No particular recurrence or deletion rule has yet been supplied.
proposals.parameters: Not yet fixed: index versus prime values, plaintext versus ciphertext versus a fixed known-page key, arithmetic and reduction, primer, direction, reset boundaries, single pass versus repeated passes, and what exactly is shed.
proposals.criterion: Freeze a finite manifest and recover a planted full message using the same parameter domain. Require substantial continuation outside any crib or parameter-fitting prefix; compare the entire selected search against controls. A short plausible word or thematic resemblance is not a successful decoding.
missing: An exact equation generating each next key/state value.
A literal definition of shedding: state replacement, consumed prefix, physical deletion, or a new whole-text pass; these are distinct operations.
Fixed target pages, transcription, known-text source and ordering.
A source-justified seed/key manifest if using the parable sums, their product, or the title number; do not pick values after seeing readable fragments.
Finite bounds and stopping rule for any iterative procedure.

related_context.role: Documented LP2-57 sentence totals 1259,1031,1229, product1595277641, and 761.MP3 title/parable metadata. This is a real cross-medium connection, not evidence of an autokey rule.
Meaning of instar/emergence and the manuscript passages.
Audio spectral measurement only; cannot stand in for a decryption-method comparison.

overlap_notes: Prime-valued and multi-rune feedback already have bounded tests, including restricted primers; an exact new rule must be compared with their actual scope.
Using known manuscript readings as a fixed running key differs from a numerical autokey whose values depend on newly recovered plaintext.
The parable product appears in the existing derived-generator seed manifest, but those opening tests do not cover arbitrary recursion, iterative text replacement or every use of that seed.
The supplied AI answer overlooks relevant feedback and known-reading-key records; no-overlap/no-prior-test is not established.
proposals.retrieval_followup: Check the current Have we tried it lookup with this supplied query. Feedback/autokey and known-reading-key records should be considered before audio spectra or unrelated F-gap mappings; reproduce any omission before changing ranking.
proposals.intake_decision: One grouped proposal with related existing tests; queued for formalization, not marked untried in all forms, run, supported or disproven.
